Alex Kim: morning team — quick handoff. I'm on until 11:30 UTC. Primary changes since last shift:
• KV cache eviction threshold lowered on prod around 02:10 UTC (deployed by #deploy-ops). Watch for a small spike in tail latency for embed reads.
• Canary rollout of model v3-optim started on us-west-dedicated. Traffic 5% — fallback policy enabled.
Samir Patel: noted. I'll keep an eye on embed latencies and cache hit rate dashboards :eyes:
Jordan Lee: FYI there's a PR blocking the next canary bump — PR #4823 (quant params). I added a comment to unblock.
Taylor Rivera: thanks. Any known alerts to watch?
Alex Kim: nothing firing but watch these dashboards:
- /console/dash/kv_hits (alert threshold 80% -> notify)
- /console/dash/gpu_sched_util (if sustained >90% for 5m)
Also check logs for this error pattern if users report token errors:
```
ERROR: kv_fetch_timeout key="session_*" t=500ms
```
deploy-bot: deploy completed: kv-threshold-update v1.2.4 — https://ci.example/build/987
Samir Patel: will monitor. If kv evictions rise, recommendation: revert threshold and scale read replicas by +1 (small window rollback).
Jordan Lee: re: PR 4823 — I'm pairing with Sam to resolve param drift, aiming to merge before midday.
Taylor Rivera: handoff tasks for next shift:
1) check canary success metrics after 1h, escalate to Eng Platform if model error rate >0.5%.
2) confirm KV hit-rate stayed above 78% after 30m.
3) if GPU scheduler >90% for 10m, trigger scale-plan in runbook (link: https://runbook.internal/scale-gpu)
Samir Patel: pinging @oncall-next for swap — I need 30m out at 10:10 UTC.
Alex Kim: noted, @oncall-next Jordan will take 10:10-13:10 UTC window. Jordan OK? :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: I got it.
Taylor Rivera: small FYI for follow-ups: I'll open an audit ticket for the canary metric gaps (possible missing traces), and add a test to the eval suite for kv edge cases.
Alex Kim: thanks all. leaving bridge notes in Google doc: https://docs.example/handoffs/2026-03-18-pre-dawn
Samir Patel: TY. Leaving: cpu anomalies on worker-7 observed 03:05 UTC — added annotation to the timeline.
Jordan Lee: taking over now. If anything urgent, @pager oncall.
deploy-bot: reminder: automated snapshot at 03:30 UTC
